quests.name: First Steps
quests.description: Learn the basics of adventuring by speaking with the local guard captain.
quests.description_ru: Изучите основы приключений, поговорив с местным капитаном стражи.
quests.dialog_accept: Welcome, adventurer! There's much to learn in these lands.
quests.dialog_progress: Have you found Captain Marcus yet?
quests.dialog_complete: Well done! You're ready for your first real challenge.

quests.name: Goblin Threat
quests.description: Goblins have been spotted near the village. Eliminate them before they become a bigger problem.
quests.description_ru: Гоблины замечены рядом с деревней. Уничтожьте их, пока они не стали серьёзной проблемой.
quests.dialog_accept: Those green menaces have been causing trouble. Deal with them!
quests.dialog_progress: Keep at it! Those goblins won't defeat themselves.
quests.dialog_complete: Excellent work! The village is safer thanks to you.

quests.name: Lost Supplies
quests.description: A merchant lost his supply crates near the old mill. Help him recover them.
quests.description_ru: Торговец потерял ящики с припасами возле старой мельницы. Помогите ему их найти.
quests.dialog_accept: I lost some valuable goods near the old mill. Can you help me find them?
quests.dialog_complete: You found them all! Here's your reward, friend.

quests.name: Into the Darkness
quests.description: Strange sounds have been reported from the nearby cave. Investigate and report back.
quests.description_ru: Из ближайшей пещеры доносятся странные звуки. Исследуйте и доложите.
quests.dialog_accept: We need someone brave to check out that cave. Are you up for it?
quests.dialog_progress: Be careful in there. We don't know what lurks in the darkness.
quests.dialog_complete: Undead? This is troubling news. Thank you for the report.

quests.name: Undead Menace
quests.description: The cave is infested with undead. Clear them out and find the source of the necromantic energy.
quests.description_ru: Пещера кишит нежитью. Очистите её и найдите источник некромантической энергии.
quests.dialog_accept: We must stop this undead threat before it spreads. Go into that cave and end it!
quests.dialog_progress: Have you found the source of this evil yet?
quests.dialog_complete: A dark altar... This explains everything. We must investigate further.

quests.name: Medicinal Herbs
quests.description: The village healer needs herbs to prepare medicines. Gather them from the forest.
quests.description_ru: Деревенскому целителю нужны травы для лекарств. Соберите их в лесу.
quests.dialog_accept: I always need more herbs for my potions. Can you help gather some?
quests.dialog_complete: Perfect! These will help many people. Come back anytime you find more.

quests.name: Safe Passage
quests.description: Escort the traveling merchant safely to the next village.
quests.description_ru: Сопроводите путешествующего торговца до следующей деревни.
quests.dialog_accept: The roads are dangerous these days. Will you protect me on my journey?
quests.dialog_progress: We must keep moving. It's not safe to linger.
quests.dialog_complete: Thank you for bringing the merchant safely. The guild will hear of your service.
